title: Tief Gibbs for State Senate 2026 – A 2026 California State Senate campaign site for Tief Gibbs of Novato. Tief co-owns Vintage Vehicles, has an Economics degree from San Diego State, and advocates for small businesses. She supports limited government, fiscal responsibility, public safety, parental rights in education, secure borders, religious freedom, and Second Amendment protections.
